purpose: Confirm or reject, on genuinely later outcomes, whether stock-level short-horizon risk compression has cross-sectional predictive information specifically when the broad market is CALM.

frozen_development_boundary.prospective_signal_rule: Only signal_date > 2026-09-09 may enter V2.8.3 confirmation.

population.universe: Same official PIT Certified Mother Pool authority and stable-vendor-symbol exclusions as the frozen V2.8.1 architecture, advanced prospectively under their own effective-date rules.
population.economic_return: D+10 source-close economic return with D and T endpoints taken from the same retained T-vintage snapshot.
population.secondary_return: D+5 under the same endpoint-vintage rule.

market_state.rv10: population standard deviation ddof=0 of latest 10 daily log returns ending at D
market_state.rv60: population standard deviation ddof=0 of latest 60 daily log returns ending at D
market_state.threshold_rationale: Identity threshold fixed before prospective outcomes; not estimated from returns.

primary_statistics.within_date_statistic: Spearman correlation between factor and D+10 economic return among eligible stocks on CALM dates.
primary_statistics.direction_adjustment: Multiply raw IC by -1 so positive adjusted IC means lower risk-ratio ranks predict higher forward returns.
primary_statistics.sector_context_reporting: Descriptive/robustness only; it cannot change H1/H2 eligibility or PASS status.

conditioner_validation.contrast: For each hypothesis compute mean direction-adjusted D+10 IC on CALM dates minus mean direction-adjusted D+10 IC on STRESSED dates.
conditioner_validation.interpretation: A positive contrast supports the claim that the information is stronger in CALM than STRESSED conditions.

minimum_information_before_decision.insufficient_data_action: INCOMPLETE_NOT_FAIL; accumulate genuinely later observations without changing this contract.

inference.bootstrap: 20-signal-date circular moving-block bootstrap within the prospectively accumulated date series
inference.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across H1 and H2 one-sided D+10 CALM-state IC p-values
inference.one_sided_null: Centered bootstrap null using the same method family as V2.8.1, with deterministic new V2.8.3 seeds frozen in implementation before first result.
inference.secondary_horizon: Direction-adjusted mean D+5 IC must be >0; no separate multiplicity significance requirement.

pass_requires_each_hypothesis: mean direction-adjusted D+10 IC on CALM dates > 0
95% block-bootstrap confidence interval for CALM mean direction-adjusted D+10 IC excludes zero above
CALM minus STRESSED mean direction-adjusted D+10 IC contrast > 0
95% block-bootstrap confidence interval for the CALM minus STRESSED contrast excludes zero above
direction-adjusted mean D+5 IC on CALM dates > 0
positive CALM-state direction-adjusted D+10 mean IC in at least two-thirds of valid prospective calendar quarters
leave-one-valid-prospective-quarter-out CALM-state mean direction-adjusted D+10 IC remains >0 for every omission
no implementation, source-integrity, PIT, endpoint-vintage or data-quality blocker is active

family_decision.partial_replication: Exactly one of H1/H2 PASS; retain as research evidence but do not authorize production score or trading.
family_decision.architecture_rejected: Neither H1 nor H2 PASS after minimum information requirements are satisfied.
family_decision.incomplete: Minimum information requirements are not yet satisfied.

anti_optional_stopping: H1 and H2 remain in the family regardless of interim appearance.
No CALM threshold, factor transform, direction, horizon, minimum count or PASS condition may be altered after prospective outcomes are observed under this version.
No evaluation on signal dates <=2026-09-09 can count as V2.8.3 confirmation.
Any changed hypothesis requires a new version and a new unseen boundary.
promotion_effect: A future V2.8.3 architecture confirmation would justify subsequent combination/setup research only. It does not itself emit a Setup/Episode or authorize live trading.
